description: This file defines classes and methods for fetching and processing ECB yield curve data, including query parameter models, data transformation, and data extraction functions.

classes.name: ECBYieldCurveQueryParams
classes.description: Model for ECB yield curve query parameters, including rating, yield curve type, and cache usage.

classes.name: ECBYieldCurveData
classes.description: Data model for ECB yield curve data.

classes.name: ECBYieldCurveFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving and processing ECB yield curve data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an ECBYieldCurveQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches yield curve data from ECB API, with caching support.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured ECBYieldCurveData instances, filtering for nearest dates.
